# Copilot instructions

**Do not put project rules here.** They live in one place, at the repository root:

> **[`.opencode-rules.md`](.opencode-rules.md)** — how we work: verification before
> believing, the MAUI traps this codebase has actually hit, the branch-per-feature and
> change-record process, the comment policy, how to split a file, how to build a chip and
> an icon, and the responsibility zones between `Core`, `CafePos.Presentation`, the app and
> the tests.

This file was ignored until 2026-10-07 and carried a copy of one rule, which is how two
files drift apart. A pointer cannot drift.
